units.source_text: 说真的，白天应该让女人读报给自己听的。

en.t: To tell the truth, during the day he should have had the woman read the newspaper aloud to him.

units.source_text: 那样的话，还可以打搅女人的睡眠，起到一石二鸟的效果。

en.t: That way, he could also have disturbed the woman's sleep, killing two birds with one stone.

units.source_text: 可惜的是，他自己竟先睡熟了。

en.t: Unfortunately, he himself had fallen sound asleep first.

units.source_text: 那样拼命熬着，没想到竟会如此的愚蠢。

en.t: After struggling so desperately to stay awake, it was absurd that he had ended up being so foolish.
